asks: Would you like to shake one?
description: A person built entirely from hands, fitted edge to edge with no gaps at all, each one a slightly different size so the tiling closes perfectly. They are folded into the shape of somebody standing politely.
emotes: {it} ripples from the ankle upward as the tiling redistributes.
{it} opens and closes, all over, once.
{it} gestures, and the gesture is made of smaller copies of itself.
looks: The tiling is exact. Every finger lies in the hollow of the next hand along.
The ones at the shoulder are enormous and the ones at the eyelids are very small indeed.
They all move at once, and the shape of a person is what the movement adds up to.
name: a figure tiled out of hands
says: It fits. That is the entire point of it.
There is no leftover. Look as long as you like.
Every one of these is doing its share.
